caption: The drawing presents a detailed side view of a horse-drawn wagon, characterized by a rectangular wooden compartment with a brown finish, reinforced by silver-colored metallic framework. The wagon consists of four large spoked wheels painted yellow with metallic hubs and rims, and the undercarriage is exposed, revealing its structural components. On the side panel, there is a circular yellow logo bordered in black, displaying the words "CHARLES ABBE & CO. MILWAUKEE, WIS." surrounding an intersecting axe and ladder motif in red and black, with a white background in the center of the circle. Above the compartment, there are silver rails, and at the rear, a raised driver's seat with a curved backrest and armrests. Over the wagon is a folding, metal-framed support structure. To the right, a less detailed pencil sketch illustrates the wagon’s rear view, showing the frame, seat, and wheels. Below the wagon are two additional pencil sketches; one depicts a straight wooden bar, and the other shows a pair of connected metal chains or harnesses typical for horse-drawn vehicles. The background is an off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's name "DONALD HUMPHREY 1937" is inscribed near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Bottler's Wagon
